title.en: Your Smartphone as a Business Tool
title.sw: Simu Yako ya Mkononi kama Chombo cha Biashara

description.en: Organize apps, manage storage, and use screenshots for business.
description.sw: Panga programu, simamia hifadhi, na tumia picha za skrini kwa biashara.
description.am: አፕሊኬሽኖችን ያደራጁ፣ ማከማቻን ያስተዳድሩ፣ ለንግድ ቅጽበታዊ ገጽ ያንሱ።

description.en: Set up WhatsApp Business, create catalog, and auto-replies.
description.sw: Weka WhatsApp Business, unda katalogi, na majibu ya kiotomatiki.
description.am: WhatsApp Business ያዘጋጁ፣ ካታሎግ ይፍጠሩ፣ ራስ-ሰር ምላሾችን ያዘጋጁ።

description.en: Create a simple inventory or expense tracker spreadsheet.
description.sw: Unda lahajedwali rahisi la kufuatilia hesabu au matumizi.
description.am: ቀላል የእቃ ዝርዝር ወይም የወጪ መከታተያ ስፕሬድሺት ይፍጠሩ።

description.en: Search effectively, evaluate sources, and find market prices.
description.sw: Tafuta kwa ufanisi, tathmini vyanzo, na pata bei za soko.
description.am: ውጤታማ ፍለጋ፣ ምንጮችን ይገምግሙ፣ የገበያ ዋጋዎችን ያግኙ።

title.sw: Pesa za Simu na Malipo ya Kidijitali

description.en: Set up and manage mobile money for business transactions.
description.sw: Weka na simamia pesa za simu kwa miamala ya biashara.
description.am: ለንግድ ግብይቶች ሞባይል ገንዘብ ያዘጋጁ እና ያስተዳድሩ።

description.en: Create a Google Business profile and basic social media presence.
description.sw: Unda wasifu wa Google Business na uwepo wa msingi wa mitandao ya kijamii.
description.am: Google Business መገለጫ እና መሰረታዊ ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ይፍጠሩ።

description.en: Understand how mobile money works and why it matters for your business.
description.sw: Elewa jinsi pesa za simu zinavyofanya kazi na kwa nini ni muhimu kwa biashara yako.
description.am: ሞባይል ገንዘብ እንዴት እንደሚሰራ እና ለንግድዎ ለምን አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ይረዱ።

description.en: Register and set up your MTN Mobile Money account for business use.
description.sw: Jisajili na uweke akaunti yako ya MTN Mobile Money kwa matumizi ya biashara.
description.am: ለንግድ አገልግሎት የMTN Mobile Money መለያዎን ያስመዝግቡ እና ያዘጋጁ።

description.en: Learn to accept payments via mobile money and track transactions.
description.sw: Jifunze kupokea malipo kupitia pesa za simu na kufuatilia miamala.
description.am: በሞባይል ገንዘብ ክፍያዎችን መቀበል እና ግብይቶችን መከታተል ይማሩ።

title.en: Saving and Budgeting with Mobile Money
title.sw: Kuhifadhi na Kupanga Bajeti na Pesa za Simu
title.am: በሞባይል ገንዘብ ቁጠባ እና በጀት ማውጣት

description.en: Use mobile money savings features and create a business budget.
description.sw: Tumia vipengele vya akiba vya pesa za simu na uunde bajeti ya biashara.
description.am: የሞባይል ገንዘብ ቁጠባ ባህሪያትን ይጠቀሙ እና የንግድ በጀት ይፍጠሩ።

description.en: Protect your mobile money account from fraud and scams.
description.sw: Linda akaunti yako ya pesa za simu dhidi ya ulaghai.

description.en: Create and set up your Google account to access all free tools.
description.sw: Unda na uweke akaunti yako ya Google ili kupata zana zote za bure.
description.am: ሁሉንም ነፃ መሳሪያዎች ለማግኘት Google መለያዎን ይፍጠሩ እና ያዘጋጁ።

description.en: Create spreadsheets to track inventory, sales, and expenses on your phone.
description.sw: Unda lahajedwali za kufuatilia hesabu, mauzo, na matumizi kwenye simu yako.
description.am: በስልክዎ ላይ ክምችት፣ ሽያጭ እና ወጪዎችን ለመከታተል ስፕሬድሺቶችን ይፍጠሩ።

title.sw: Google Docs kwa Hati za Biashara

description.en: Write business letters, invoices, and simple reports using Google Docs.
description.sw: Andika barua za biashara, ankara, na ripoti rahisi kwa kutumia Google Docs.
description.am: Google Docs ን በመጠቀም የንግድ ደብዳቤዎችን፣ ደረሰኞችን እና ቀላል ሪፖርቶችን ይጻፉ።

title.sw: Google Drive kwa Hifadhi ya Faili

description.en: Organize and share business files using Google Drive on your phone.
description.sw: Panga na shiriki faili za biashara kwa kutumia Google Drive kwenye simu yako.
description.am: በስልክዎ ላይ Google Drive ን በመጠቀም የንግድ ፋይሎችን ያደራጁ እና ያጋሩ።

description.en: Put your business on Google Maps so customers can find you easily.
description.sw: Weka biashara yako kwenye Google Maps ili wateja wakupate kwa urahisi.
description.am: ደንበኞች በቀላሉ እንዲያገኝዎት ንግድዎን በGoogle Maps ላይ ያስቀምጡ።
